filed_edges: [AKIEN] WHERE DOES A TASK BERTH? Its own child a asks this and says it waits on notes/held-roots-as-stations-or-shelves. A ticket freezes into its component's history as provenance; a task defines no component, so it has no address, and Law 5 says intent and its voyage share one. Until the address rule exists the /intent and /sorted edits have nowhere to write, which is exactly why this stone has sat at BUILDME. SHARPENED 2026-09-04: the operational shape suggests most tasks are machine-generated (probes, watches, troubles) and ad-hoc tasks are one-shot and ephemeral. If machine-generated tasks berth where their generator lives (the probe's folder, the device's inbox) and ad-hoc tasks berth in a depot, the address question may dissolve rather than be answered — but this is hypothesis, not ruling.
